tool_input.description: Force-push local main to remote with safety check

result:
I hit a protection rule — the system blocks force-pushes to `main` even with `--force-with-lease`. You'll need to run this yourself to fix the divergence:

```powershell
git push --force-with-lease origin main
```

Or if that still fails:
```powershell
git push -f origin main
```

**What this does:** Your local main (e703584 "fold: merge the reversal fix") will overwrite the remote's version. The remote's "hotfix: patch the rounding bug" (5754a8c) commit will be lost, but your local history becomes canonical.

Once pushed, the CI should see your commits and either pass or fail on actual code issues rather than history divergence.
